blocks.html: Everything you need to set up WinTAK comes from Deploy App's TAK page — the WinTAK installer and your personal Client Package. Download both, then run the installer.

slides.title: Open Deploy App's TAK page
slides.html:
Open Deploy App and go to the TAK page.

  • It gives WinTAK users two downloads: the WinTAK application and your Client Package.

slides.title: Download WinTAK
slides.html:
Download the WinTAK application from the Defence Forces' designated location — the link is on the TAK page.

Important: only download Windows applications from the instructed location.

slides.title: Download your Client Package
slides.html: Press the green Download your Client Package button (also on the front page) and save the .zip file. You will point WinTAK at this package after installing.

slides.title: Extract the package and find the installer
slides.html: Find the downloaded WinTAK .zip, extract it, and locate the .msi installer inside the zip's Products folder. Double-click the .msi to open the installer.

slides.title: Run the Setup Wizard
slides.html: Install WinTAK with the Setup Wizard. Press Next, then choose the installation folder.

slides.title: Choose the install folder
slides.html: Optionally change the folder with Browse, then press Next.

slides.title: Select components — include Data Sync
slides.html:
Select the components to install. Select at least:

  • Data Sync

slides.title: Install
slides.html: Press Next. When the Wizard is ready, press Install.

slides.title: Finish
slides.html: Press Next to finish. WinTAK is now installed — next, open it and import your Client Package.
